notes.content:
Did some work on improving the game feel and optimizing the game a bit. 

Patchnotes: 
[list]
[*]Bottom portion of the screen enemies will stop shooting
[*]Switched image loading to not use SDL_Img
[*]Changed explosion effect
[*]Fixed audio not being played when needed
[*]Changed text rendering to be more efficient
[*]Reduced player hitbox size
[*]Fixed level 3 boss getting stuck
[*]Optimized rendering
[/list]
Fixed the highscores not showing the real number one. Should be stable now, thanks to all the new players.

notes.title: Update 3.1
notes.content: I would like to thank everyone for playing my game so far. As well I apologize for the poor highscore system on launch. So I've mediated it in this update, thanks for everything. I just love seeing anyone play my games.
